ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: I directly looked at the attached figure; in the figure there is a row of six square paper pieces with the same outer frame, each paper piece has a gray shape inside, and all boundary lines are horizontal or vertical. Looking from left to right, the six gray shapes respectively look like: an L shape, an H shape, a U shape, a stepped shape with opposite-corner notches, a T shape, and a cross/plus shape. Reasoning: Regard each gray shape as the remaining part after several white regions have been removed from the original square paper piece. If the white region is a notch at a corner, the two originally removed outer boundary segments will be replaced by two internal boundary segments of equal length, so the perimeter does not change. If the white region is an indentation in the middle of an edge, then besides replacing the opening width, two indentation side walls will be added, so the perimeter becomes larger. Judging one by one: the 1st L shape has only one corner notch, and the perimeter does not change; the 2nd H shape has upper and lower middle indentations, and the perimeter becomes larger; the 3rd U shape has an upper middle indentation, and the perimeter becomes larger; the 4th stepped shape has two corner notches, and the perimeter does not change; the 5th T shape can be regarded as having removed two lower-corner notches, and the perimeter does not change; the 6th cross shape can be regarded as having removed four corner notches, and the perimeter does not change. Therefore, there are 4 shapes whose perimeters are the same as that of the original square paper piece.

raw_record.question_text: Maria has drawn some shapes on identical square pieces of paper, as shown. Each line she has drawn is parallel to an edge of her paper. How many of her shapes have the same perimeter as the sheet of paper itself?

method.method_draft: Use a perimeter-cancellation check based on the white cut-out regions in each square. From the image, label the six grey shapes left to right: an L-shape, an H-like shape, a U-like shape, a stepped shape with opposite corner cut-outs, a T-shape, and a plus/cross shape. From the text, note that all sheets are identical squares and all drawn lines are parallel to the square edges, so every boundary segment is horizontal or vertical. Compare each grey shape’s perimeter with the outer square perimeter by asking how the white parts alter the original square boundary: if a white cut-out is at a corner, the two outer boundary pieces removed are replaced by two equal internal boundary pieces, so the perimeter is unchanged; if a white cut-out is a central notch along one side, the outer opening is not fully replaced and the two extra side walls increase the perimeter. Applying this to the image: the L-shape has one corner cut-out, the stepped shape has two corner cut-outs, the T-shape is the square with two lower corner cut-outs, and the plus/cross shape is the square with four corner cut-outs, so these four keep the square’s perimeter. The H-like and U-like shapes have central notches and have larger perimeter. Therefore the count is 4.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：我直接查看了附图；图中是一排六个相同外框的正方形纸片，每个纸片内有灰色形状，所有边界线都是水平或竖直的。从左到右看，六个灰色形状分别像：一个 L 形、一个 H 形、一个 U 形、一个带相对角缺口的阶梯形、一个 T 形、一个十字/加号形。

推理：把每个灰色形状看成原正方形纸片去掉若干白色区域后的剩余部分。若白色区域是角上的缺口，原来被去掉的两段外边界会被等长的两段内部边界替代，所以周长不变。若白色区域是边中间的凹口，则除了替代开口宽度外，还会多出两条凹口侧壁，因此周长变大。

逐个判断：第1个 L 形只有一个角缺口，周长不变；第2个 H 形有上下中间凹口，周长变大；第3个 U 形有上方中间凹口，周长变大；第4个阶梯形有两个角缺口，周长不变；第5个 T 形可看作去掉两个下角缺口，周长不变；第6个十字形可看作去掉四个角缺口，周长不变。所以共有 4 个形状的周长与原正方形纸片相同。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route avoids measuring or summing every individual segment; it uses a structural cancellation rule for corner cut-outs versus central notches to classify the six shapes.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the six grey shapes and identify where the white missing regions touch the square boundary: corner cut-outs for shapes 1, 4, 5, and 6; central side notches for shapes 2 and 3.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the facts that the papers are identical squares and every drawn line is parallel to an edge, so perimeter comparison can be made using horizontal/vertical segment replacement.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Key rule: removing a rectangular corner from an orthogonal square preserves perimeter because the removed outer lengths equal the added inner lengths; removing a non-corner side notch increases perimeter by adding extra side-wall lengths.
